predicate: Current authorized endpoint and exact selected profile, actor/principal and applicable fact receipt/temporal binding
Same lot shown by exact existing P_ITEM or explicit P_CACHE_STOCK/source target route; any portable-to-lot identity join separately authorized, not guessed from display Id
Actual InventoryLotRecord.OwnerId passes MayUseInventory and actual ResourceLot.CustodianId passes Controls; matching portable owner/custodian predicates where that is the public branch
Selected cache requires current P_CACHE_STOCK; trap exclusion stays; WoundTreatmentStation identities excluded from this general predicate
Actual unit equals one listed literal AND its selected source producer/lineage matches; no allowlisting by unit text alone
No private stock count, hidden lot identity, Director source, unopened cache contents or foreign-owner information is released

lineage.rule: Native descendant preserves exact source UnitId; child current rights independently required. A parent identity is not disclosed unless its current predicate also permits it.

purify.rule: Actual pre-command amount plus same actual UnitId only after original spell/target/current owner unit predicates; full available whole lot, water/food/enclosure/range/line restrictions unchanged. Later missing historical amount is NotRetained, never current substituted. Protected contamination remains fixed Withheld.

explicitExclusions.reason: Real native wound-treatment units; only exact dedicated care/claim predicates, not general own inventory unit permission. Sealed treatment stock is not command inventory.
Real selected trap bait unit, but generic ProjectItems excludes selected trap inventory; remote/local trap facts retain their independent permitted fields.
No selected connected factory initializes recipe14 manufacturing lots; source-bound specimen occurrence does not select that whole recipe. Keep wider native source without adding public units.

unsupportedBinding: Fixed quantity placeholder Withheld, no untyped number, guessed unit, null Value or hidden-unit reason. A missing required admitted-unit binding remains a qualification defect, not blanket permitted withholding.
